data.description:
## Context

Implement parent story A4-3 as one small reviewable slice. After A4-2, keys present in both the key-set previous snapshot and current snapshot can enter branch 3 with empty local fields. Those updates are filtered before Jira but still consume mutation planning, drift rechecks, git subprocesses, outcome records, and mutation-cap slots.

## Approach

Short-circuit the branch-3 emit in `compute_mutations` when the resolved effective field payload is empty. Preserve emissions for any genuine non-empty effective payload. Keep the change at the differ seam; do not alter dispatch or weaken the load-bearing production filter.

## TDD / Verification

Author the behavioral oracle RED-first. Expose only the basic key-set/empty-payload happy-path test to the implementer; hold out the genuine-payload negative control, converged pass record, and git-invocation counter.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [code-verifiable] A key-set previous snapshot over the committed corpus emits zero `(outbound, update)` mutations with an empty effective payload. Verified by focused `compute_mutations` unit coverage plus the corpus script.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A genuine non-empty effective payload still emits the same outbound update. Verified by a negative-control unit test.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A converged integration pass records `mutation_count == 0`. Verified by the persisted pass record.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The integration pass performs no per-mutation `git rev-parse` calls for the removed empty updates. Verified with a counting shim.

## Files

- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/differ.py`
- focused unit and integration tests under `tests/`

Estimated scope: S. Depends on closed A4-2 through the parent story.
data.title: A4-3 implementation: suppress empty effective branch-3 updates
